queryHistory.query: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name LIMIT 5;

customDbml:
Table users {
  id uuid [pk]
  email varchar
  full_name varchar
  role varchar
  created_at timestamptz
}

Table orders {
  id uuid [pk]
  user_id uuid [ref: > users.id]
  total_amount numeric
  status varchar
  created_at timestamptz
}
